dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mr. Brown, did you use to play with toys when you were little?
dialogue.reading: ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn, dɪd juː ˈjuːs tə ˈpleɪ wɪð ˈtɔɪz wɛn juː wɜːr ˈlɪtəl?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. I had a lot of toy cars. Did you use to play with dolls?
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, aɪ ˈdɪd. aɪ ˈhæd ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈtɔɪ ˈkɑːrz. dɪd juː ˈjuːs tə ˈpleɪ wɪð ˈdɑːlz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes! I used to pretend my dolls were my students.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs! aɪ ˈjuːst tə prɪˈtɛnd maɪ ˈdɑːlz wɜːr maɪ ˈstuːdənts.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ha! Like your parents. Did you use to watch cartoons?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! laɪk jʊr ˈpɛrənts. dɪd juː ˈjuːs tə ˈwɑːtʃ kɑːrˈtuːnz?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Every Saturday morning! Did you use to watch them, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈɛvri ˈsætərdeɪ ˈmɔːrnɪŋ! dɪd juː ˈjuːs tə ˈwɑːtʃ ðɛm, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Of course. But I used to play outside more. There was a big playground near my school.
dialogue.reading: əv ˈkɔːrs. bʌt aɪ ˈjuːst tə ˈpleɪ ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ˈmɔːr. ðɛr wʌz ə ˈbɪɡ ˈpleɪɡraʊnd ˈnɪr maɪ ˈskuːl.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: What games did you use to play?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ˈɡeɪmz dɪd juː ˈjuːs tə ˈpleɪ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hide and seek! We used to play it for hours.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪd ənd ˈsiːk! wiː ˈjuːst tə ˈpleɪ ɪt fər ˈaʊərz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me too! My cousins and I used to play hide and seek in my grandparents' village.
dialogue.reading: ˈmiː ˈtuː! maɪ ˈkʌzənz ənd aɪ ˈjuːst tə ˈpleɪ ˈhaɪd ənd ˈsiːk ɪn maɪ ˈɡrænpɛrənts ˈvɪlɪdʒ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Children everywhere play the same games!
dialogue.reading: ˈtʃɪldrən ˈɛvriwɛr ˈpleɪ ðə ˈseɪm ˈɡeɪmz!
